categories.label: Trophies
categories.intro: The full list of 55 trophies and achievements. Story and secret ones keep their names hidden here so nothing is spoiled.

categories.label: Story missions
categories.intro: Every main story mission, in chapter order. Names stay hidden until you've played them.

categories.label: Strangers & Freaks
categories.intro: Side missions from the strangers you meet around Leonida, one strand per stranger. Who they are stays hidden until you've played them.

categories.label: Tasks & robberies
categories.intro: The game's own 100% checklist: optional tasks, stick ups, vaults and fencing. Each row counts up to what 100% needs. Bank jobs, payday loans and Smash 'N' Grabs have their own lists.

categories.label: Exploration & activities
categories.intro: The rest of the game's own 100% checklist: each row counts up to what 100% needs, and the guide says how many there are in all. Card sets, meditation, playlists, video games, pool, mini golf and shooting ranges, race challenges and challenges have their own lists.

categories.label: Discovery
categories.intro: The game's own 100% checklist: vehicles, weapons and animals.

categories.label: Card sets
categories.intro: 18 trading card sets, 480 cards in all, spread across Leonida. 100% needs 15 complete sets. The Don't Touch My Deck trophy needs 3.

categories.label: Meditation
categories.intro: 18 meditations at 10 spots: most spots have two. 100% needs 15 of the 18; the Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs every spot.

categories.label: Unique playlists
categories.intro: 2 unique playlists, unlocked by finding their posters.

categories.label: Video games
categories.intro: 4 video games to play through. Three are on the home console; one is an arcade machine. Finishing any one of them earns the Stick Fiddler trophy.

categories.label: Mini golf
categories.intro: 3 mini golf courses. 100% needs 2 of them.

categories.label: Shooting ranges
categories.intro: 12 courses at two ranges, 42 challenges in all, each with a gold medal to earn. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the range's clerk first. Tick a challenge once you have its gold.

categories.label: Pool opponents
categories.intro: 7 pool opponents at bars around Leonida. 100% needs 5 of them.

categories.label: Bank jobs
categories.intro: 22 banks to rob: 14 small banks (cash drawer and safe) open up in chapter 3, and 8 large banks with a vault open up in chapter 4. 100% needs every one fully done.

categories.label: Payday loans
categories.intro: 7 payday loan stores to rob, open from chapter 3. 100% needs all 7. Watch out for dye packs in the cash.

categories.label: Smash 'N' Grabs
categories.intro: 35 pawn shops and jewelry stores. Pawn shops open up in chapter 2, jewelry stores in chapter 3. 100% needs 34 of the 35.

categories.label: Race challenges
categories.intro: 13 race challenges, each with bronze, silver and gold. 100% needs gold in 10 of them.

categories.label: Challenges
categories.intro: 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, all open from the start. 100% needs 70; the One Last Thing trophy needs 50. The game tracks them under Progress, Challenges.

categories.label: Cocaine Flamingos
categories.intro: 125 Cocaine Flamingos hidden around Leonida; 100% needs 100. Only the ones with a black and white beak count: shoot one to break it open. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Magazines, books & comics
categories.intro: 27 magazines, books and comics. 100% needs 30 of these plus book swaps combined. Several are only there in early chapters. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Book swaps
categories.intro: 7 little book swap boxes. They count with magazines, books and comics towards 100%. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: WAiNK scans
categories.intro: Scan with the WAiNK app: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. 100% needs 100. Numbers follow the game's Progress menu. More are added as guides find them. The You WAiNKer! trophy needs 100.

categories.label: Stunt jumps
categories.intro: 130 stunt jumps. They count towards the stunts line of 100% (300 of 397 stunts, with under the bridges, knife flights and base jumps). More are added as guides find them. Stunt jumps also count towards the Cunning Stunts trophy (250 stunts).

categories.label: Unique races
categories.intro: 40 unique races in 6 groups. 100% needs 30 wins; the Earn Cash, Not Kudos trophy needs 20.

categories.label: Drone time trials
categories.intro: Top Fun drone time trials: 14 locations with 3 trials each, 42 in all, listed south to north. Beat the target time in each. The Top Fun trophy needs a win at every location.

categories.label: Gang operations
categories.intro: 39 illegal gang operations to clear. They open up through the story as you meet each gang. 100% needs all 39. Names stay hidden until you've done them. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Drug labs
categories.intro: 14 synthetic drug labs to destroy with fire or explosives, from chapter 3. They count as optional tasks. Names stay hidden until you've done them. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Animals
categories.intro: 255 animals in 8 groups to study with binoculars (aim, then hold R1/RB). Each dog and cat breed counts on its own. 100% needs any 100. Species get their own rows as they're found; each group ends with a counter for the ones not listed yet.

categories.label: Vehicles
categories.intro: The game's Vehicles log, section by section, with each model's base stats. A vehicle is discovered once you've been in it. Cars and service vehicles come in 15 classes; bikes, watercraft and aircraft are one list each. That's 277 models, and the game's 100% checklist needs 200 base models. Each section ends with a counter for the ones not listed yet. The Standout sets aren't here yet.

categories.label: Kenton's Treasures
categories.intro: Kenton's shipwrecks: 6 wrecks off Key Lento and the Keys. Wreck 1 has 10 doubloons, and the other five have 30 treasures between them. Kenton marks each wreck on your map; find the treasures with the metal detector and hand them to him. 100% counts his sets (5 of 7 on the checklist). He's away for a while after chapter 1 and is back by chapter 3, and everything stays open after the story.

pois.title: Story mission 1
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia sits down with a prison counselor about her arrest and her chance of getting out early.

pois.title: Story mission 2
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: A smuggling run falls apart and Jason has to get Donnie away from the Kingfishers in Pelican Valley. Back home in the Keys, Lucia phones with news of her early release.

pois.title: Story mission 3
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes to Ammu-Nation for a long gun.

pois.title: Story mission 4
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes his Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care to get it fixed up.

pois.title: Story mission 5
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Collecting rent for Brian at a gift shop that fronts for an acid lab, Jason leaves with product when there's no cash.

pois.title: Story mission 6
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Cal go to Hamlet after money Brian is owed. It's in the trunk of a car in the police impound, so Jason takes the car, resprays it and delivers it to Brian's storage.

pois.title: Story mission 7
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Collecting rent from Mandy, one of Brian's tenants, Jason ends up doing some repairs around her place.

pois.title: Story mission 8
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: After the trouble with the Kingfishers, Brian's broker Arnold stops answering. Jason and Cal track him down and it turns into a confrontation.

pois.title: Story mission 9
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes a bachelor party diving on a wreck as cover for Kenton's treasure hunt. The dive goes wrong, but he finds treasure and agrees to work with Kenton.

pois.title: Story mission 10
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Cal move the furniture around to get the house ready for Lucia, on what may be Jason's last night single.

pois.title: Story mission 11
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia is released and Jason takes her to the Rusty Anchor to celebrate. Her old cellmate Kat turns up with her wealthy boyfriend Mattia, and a fight cuts the night short.

pois.title: Story mission 12
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Lucia try to open a joint bank account, get turned down, and settle for the BuckMe app.

pois.title: Story mission 13
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes into the Grassrivers for a package Donnie dropped while drunk.

pois.title: Story mission 14
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes Lucia along on a smuggling flight in Brian's seaplane and they run into trouble with Brian's new suppliers. Lucia has missed calls from her P.O., and they only just make it home in time.

pois.title: Story mission 15
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: After guiding a smuggling plane in under the radar, Donnie talks Jason into a detour to sell stolen product to a biker gang. It goes badly, and Jason gets them out alive.

pois.title: Story mission 16
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Mattia has Lucia's ankle tag taken off and takes the pair out on a yacht and to a club in Vice City. The next morning he offers them a well-paid job fetching a bag from a locker, and Jason isn't convinced.

pois.title: Story mission 17
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes with Brian and Lori to settle Donnie's trouble with the Kingfishers, and it's a setup. Jason finds Donnie dead, Lori is taken, and a chase across the Grassrivers gets her back. Brian says he's done with smuggling.

pois.title: Story mission 18
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Brian asks Jason to go to Donnie's trailer and make it look as though he left town.

pois.title: Story mission 19
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Cal is taking Donnie's death hard, so Jason and Lucia take him fishing and say their goodbyes.

pois.title: Story mission 20
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: The locker job is on. Jason and Lucia collect the bag in disguise and are arrested, then dirty cops attack and Jason is badly hurt. They get away with the bag and Cal drives Jason to hospital.

pois.title: Story mission 21
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: With Jason heading to hospital, Lucia goes home for his stash and is attacked by masked men after the bag. She gets away, and the house burns down.

pois.title: Story mission 22
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia reaches Jason at the hospital in Vice City, where the dirty cops and the masked men are waiting. They fight their way out and run west to Kelly County.

pois.title: Story mission 23
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason comes round in a Port Gellhorn motel. The dirty cop from the Visitor Center is on the news blaming them, and the bag turns out to hold an old statue and a hard drive.

pois.title: Story mission 24
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia goes to dump the ambulance she escaped in and walks in on a gang trying to steal it.

pois.title: Story mission 25
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: With Jason laid up, Lucia fetches supplies from a gas station near the motel.

pois.title: Story mission 26
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason needs painkillers. Lucia meets Vicki, a dancer who shows her around Port Gellhorn and introduces her to Dunk, a local dealer who says he can help.

pois.title: Story mission 27
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia meets the mechanic Moses Watkins, who hands her a slim jim and offers to fence any untracked cars she brings him.

pois.title: Story mission 28
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Moses wants a particular Canis Crawler and pays Lucia to steal it.

pois.title: Story mission 29
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Dunk and Lucia kidnap a crooked local doctor to get Jason proper painkillers. His meeting with the Kolts turns into a fight and the doctor is killed, but Jason gets his pills and Dunk becomes a contact for selling narcotics.

pois.title: Albino American Alligator
pois.guide: Rare white alligator that turns up now and then in the swamps. Dangerous; shoot from range.

pois.title: American Alligator
pois.guide: Big swamp predator that hides well; keep your distance.

pois.title: American Crocodile
pois.guide: Leonida's biggest reptile, at home in salt water along the coast.

pois.title: American Red Fox
pois.guide: Bigger than a gray fox, with a white tail tip. Lives in the northern forests.

pois.title: Black Fox
pois.guide: Rare black-furred fox, seen in several parts of Leonida. A light rifle keeps the pelt clean.

pois.title: Box Turtle
pois.guide: Small turtle that shuts itself inside its shell; easiest to find in the swamps.

pois.title: Canada Goose
pois.guide: Black head, white cheeks. Common on fresh water and in town parks, and it will charge you.

pois.title: Cane Toad
pois.guide: Huge toad that lives mostly in the swamps. A heavy gun spoils the pelt.

pois.title: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
pois.guide: Listen for the rattle in the forests. Its bite can kill, so take care.

pois.title: Eastern Gray Squirrel
pois.guide: Common everywhere, usually busy with nuts and seeds. An easy shot with a light rifle.

pois.title: Golden Fox
pois.guide: Rare golden-furred red fox from the northern forests. Go gentle to keep the pelt.

pois.title: Green Iguana
pois.guide: Invasive lizard all over the warm south, towns included, usually near water.

pois.title: Leonida Cottonmouth
pois.guide: Venomous swamp snake with dark bands around a thick body.

pois.title: Leonida Kingsnake
pois.guide: Mid-sized brown constrictor with yellow bands, in forests and grassland. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Leonida Wild Turkey
pois.guide: Big turkey of the forests and grassy lowlands. Go gentle to keep the carcass.

pois.title: Leonida Wild White Tom
pois.guide: Rare white-feathered wild turkey, in forests and grassy lowlands.

pois.title: Marsh Rabbit
pois.guide: Shy little rabbit of the swamps and southern coast; a light rifle does it.

pois.title: Mottled Duck
pois.guide: Freshwater duck with a glossy blue patch on each wing.

pois.title: North American River Otter
pois.guide: Dark brown otter of the swamps, sometimes along rivers.

pois.title: Northern Black Coyote
pois.guide: Rare black-furred coyote of the forests and swamps. Keep your distance.

pois.title: Northern Coyote
pois.guide: Red-gray coyote with big ears that hunts in packs through forests and swamps. Best taken at long range.

pois.title: Northern Raccoon
pois.guide: Out at night, raiding bins in town as happily as it lives in forests and swamps.

pois.title: Nutria
pois.guide: Invasive water rodent that looks like an oversized rat, found in the swamps. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Round-Tailed Muskrat
pois.guide: Small water rodent with a compact body and a long scaly tail, near swamps and fresh water.

pois.title: Softshell Turtle
pois.guide: Swamp turtle with a long snorkel nose; a light rifle is enough.

pois.title: Spectacled Caiman
pois.guide: Smaller cousin of the alligator, just as tough.

pois.title: Whitetail Deer
pois.guide: Grazes in woods, swamps and grassy lowlands. Spooks easily, so shoot from far off.

pois.title: Wild Boar
pois.guide: Aggressive forager of woods and swamps, out mostly at night.

pois.title: Atlantic Spadefish
pois.guide: Round, striped fish found along most of the coast.

pois.title: Atlantic Spanish Mackerel
pois.guide: Slim silver fish with yellow spots, all along the coast.

pois.title: Atlantic Tarpon
pois.guide: Big silver-green fish, in shallow and deep sea alike.

pois.title: Bluestriped Grunt
pois.guide: Yellow fish with bright blue stripes, in the warm southern waters.

pois.title: Cobia
pois.guide: Brown-banded fish of the deep sea around Leonida.

pois.title: Common Snook
pois.guide: Has a thin black stripe along its side; off the east coast.

pois.title: Great Barracuda
pois.guide: Toothy silver-blue hunter off the south coast and in deeper water.

pois.title: Green Moray Eel
pois.guide: Green eel living in the coastal coral reefs.

pois.title: Hogfish
pois.guide: Pink fish with a pig-like snout, in warm coastal water.

pois.title: Littlehead Porgy
pois.guide: Tall flat face with blue stripes. In coastal water to the south and west.

pois.title: Mahi-Mahi
pois.guide: Blue-green with a bulging head; reefs and deeper water.

pois.title: Northern Red Snapper
pois.guide: Bright red, thick-bodied fish, most common in the warmer south.

pois.title: Red Lionfish
pois.guide: Invasive, with venomous striped spines. In coastal water to the south.

pois.title: Spotted Moray Eel
pois.guide: Spotted eel hiding in the coastal reefs.

pois.title: Stoplight Parrotfish
pois.guide: Colourful fish with a yellow spot near its gills.

pois.title: Tiger Grouper
pois.guide: Striped grouper found across the southern and western waters.

pois.title: Yellowtail Snapper
pois.guide: Yellow forked tail; southern coast and deeper western water.

pois.title: Alpine Goat
pois.guide: Horned, bearded farm goat that will charge if you get careless.

pois.title: Bottlenose Dolphin
pois.guide: Common in the sea all around Leonida; long snout.

pois.title: Brown Rat
pois.guide: Lives anywhere people do, and there are always more of them.

pois.title: Holstein Cattle
pois.guide: The black and white dairy cows on Leonida's farms.

pois.title: Short-Beaked Common Dolphin
pois.guide: Smaller dolphin off the coast with an hourglass pattern on its side.

pois.title: Balinese
pois.guide: Long-haired pet cat with blue eyes.

pois.title: Calico
pois.guide: Black, white and orange cat, at home indoors or out on the street.

pois.title: Ginger Longhair
pois.guide: Long-furred ginger cat, common in town and beyond.

pois.title: Ginger Tabby
pois.guide: The ginger street cat you see all over Leonida.

pois.title: Striped Tabby
pois.guide: Street and alley cat with the tabby's dark M on its forehead.

pois.title: American Pit Bull Terrier
pois.guide: Stocky, powerful dog with a smooth head, kept as a pet or a guard dog.

pois.title: Doberman Pinscher
pois.guide: Sleek, athletic guard dog; like a Rottweiler but leaner.

pois.title: German Shepherd
pois.guide: Fast, strong and clever; the police and guard dog with the thick coat.

pois.title: Green Sea Turtle
pois.guide: Biggest hard-shelled turtle, around reefs and the coast.

pois.title: American Crow
pois.guide: Clever black bird on trees and rooftops everywhere.

pois.title: American Robin
pois.guide: Small songbird with a red breast and dark head, in town and country.

pois.title: American White Ibis
pois.guide: White wading bird with a curved orange beak, on fresh water near the coast and in the swamps.

pois.title: American White Pelican
pois.guide: The bigger of the two pelicans; swamps, rivers and coast.

pois.title: Bald Eagle
pois.guide: White-headed bird of prey, seen hunting small animals across Leonida.

pois.title: Black Vulture
pois.guide: Black carrion bird with a gray-black head, turning up in several regions.

pois.title: Blue Jay
pois.guide: Bright blue with a crest, flocking in the forests and sometimes in town.

pois.title: Caspian Tern
pois.guide: Large tern with a black cap and orange bill, all round the coast.

pois.title: Common Loon
pois.guide: Black and white water bird with red eyes; great in water and air, hopeless on land.

pois.title: Double-Crested Cormorant
pois.guide: Black water bird with a hooked bill and orange face.

pois.title: Eastern Brown Pelican
pois.guide: Coastal pelican, in towns too, that dives for fish.
